obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your membership

results.segment: This letter confirms your appointment about your membership with Eastvale Library Service on 10 January 2026 at 10.40am.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you can no longer attend, our reception team will be glad to offer the time to somebody else.
This is the last letter you will receive about the works, which finished on 6 February.
